You gets a pile of fries or baked potato, creamy coleslaw and hushpuppies.   Choose from a combination of: • Fried Shrimp• Fried Fish Fillets• Fried Stuffed Crab• Fried Oysters• Boiled Shrimp• Grilled Shrimp• Fried Clam Strips• Chicken Strips It’s available to combine two, three, or four different items, but you may not duplicate items. Welcome to Doc’s Seafood and Steaks, Orange Beach, Alabama Famous Fried Shrimp, Seafood Platters, Seafood Gumbo, Oysters, Fish, and Steaks Doc’s Seafood & Steaks in Orange Beach, Alabama is the Premier seafood and steak restaurant on the Gulf Coast. With over 34 years in business serving the great people of Orange Beach and Gulf Shores, Alabama, Doc’s now brings you Certified Angus Steak as you’ve never tasted it before. Our new restaurant pulled out all the stops to bring a fresh menu, including our world-famous shrimp and now delicious premium steaks. Doc’s specializes in four types of steaks with their own blend of seasoning and spices to perfectly marinate and flavor your favorite cut of meat. Seasoning blends in the south create a flavor all its own, giving southern cooking its rich identity. That’s what Doc’s does best. Doc’s Seafood and Steaks is known for “the best-fried shrimp in the entire civilized world” on the Gulf Coast. Now you can add a delicious steak to any Seafood dish. We provide only the freshest premium steak of the highest quality. Doc’s Seafood and Steaks is offering four types of premium steak: the T-bone, the Rib-eye, the New York Strip, and the Filet Mignon. Not sure which steak to try first? Well, you can return as often as you like to try each one! You can try a different steak with seafood each time you visit our restaurant. Our friendly and courteous staff are ready to serve you delicious seafood and exceptional steak. Doc’s Seafood and Steaks offers a delicious variety of food such as fried shrimp, crab claws, redskin potatoes, cheese grits, fried oysters, grilled shrimp, vegetables and now steaks. But of course, the number one menu item we are known for is our “World Famous Shrimp.” That’s right, and no one cooks great shrimp better than Doc’s. We provide the best-cooked seafood at an affordable price. Can’t decide which plate to try? We have a “build your own platter plate” so you can enjoy a variety of menu items at once. Our seafood is always fresh, always hot, and always ready for your enjoyment. Have a time crunch and need to grab and go? No problem! Our friendly and courteous staff is ready to wrap and prepare the food so you can enjoy your seafood and steak anywhere. Download our seafood menus for quick to-go ordering. Do you have an event coming up and need seafood catering? Call Doc’s today and discuss all of your seafood and steak catering options. We never shy away from an opportunity to provide quality seafood and steaks at an affordable price.
